name: @magpie-community/page-harnessweight
description: HarnessWeight: a magpie page that weighs every agent harness behind your gateway, by agent rather than by model: input tokens, cache hit rate, tokens at full price, failures, latency, and the tool definitions each harness re-sends every turn

summary.en: Compare agent harnesses behind your gateway by input tokens, cache, failures, latency and estimated tool-definition size. Its local service reads this machine's usage ledger; a read-only hook samples tool sizes and tracks in-flight requests.
summary.zh: 按 Agent 对比网关后面的输入 token、缓存、失败率、延迟与工具定义体积估算。本机服务读取用量记录，只读 hook 采样工具大小并追踪进行中的请求。

author: webkubor
